q1: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2: SELECT EMAIL FROM (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(*) FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS A
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL AS EMAIL FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(EMAIL) >1
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT EMAIL FROM (SELECT EMAIL, COUNT(*) FROM PERSON GROUP BY EMAIL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) AS A
explanation: Both Q1 and Q2 are designed to find emails that are associated with more than one person in the PERSON table. They achieve this by grouping the records by the EMAIL column and then filtering out the groups where the count of records is greater than 1. The results are the same as they both select the EMAIL column from the filtered groups.
